summary: The note describes the Iron Grip Barbell Company, a manufacturer of commercial free weight equipment headquartered in Santa Ana, California. It was founded in 1993 and its website claims it is the only company still making a complete line of such equipment in the United States. The note also says the company holds many patents and is internationally known.
